example.title: Keim Stone Arch Bridge, 624 Avenue south of 729 Road

brief: Small rubble-stone arch culvert of 1916 under a gravel county road in a wooded draw: a single semicircular arch of rough-split grey limestone voussoirs in random-rubble headwalls and wing walls, with stone end blocks and a two-line iron pipe rail between them on each side. A cast plaque set in the west parapet lists the three county commissioners and the year. Overgrown with brush and small trees.

names.plate: G. BRUNSTETTER · G. D. ROWELL · E. B. PLATTNER · COMS. 1916
